source_text: The mutilation narrative, dominant in Western human rights and media discourses, posits inherent physical, sexual, and psychological devastation, often extrapolating from severe Type III infibulation cases (prevalent in <10% of instances globally) to all forms, while downplaying self-reports of normalcy.
